method: US English; answer text only; remove Markdown emphasis/code markers; collapse whitespace; library sentence segmentation; arithmetic mean of per-report scores; whitespace word counts for report length; descriptive post-hoc comparison, not a test of human comprehension.

applicability.smog: All numerical results retained; reports below 30 sentences are flagged, because they fall outside the usual norming sample length.
applicability.spache: Targets children's text up to grade four; supplementary only here.
applicability.mcalpine_eflaw: Targets English as a foreign language; supplementary only here.
applicability.consensus_grade: Library consensus combines correlated formulae, including SMOG; not an independent or better-validated measure.
applicability.scope: Common English-compatible indices plus consensus; other-language formulae excluded. Only Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level is reported in the paper.
